check.reason: The target is the system: Epic's gatekeeping and integration review, and the tech hype around health care AI. It does not mock patients, the reporter, or any private individual. It stays consistent with the story's premise that AI companies must contend with Epic. It invents no numbers, quotes, or results, and it quotes nothing from the article. It avoids death, children, and violence. The tone is dry and deadpan, and the irony of 'disruption pending integration review' makes it satirical. The line about physicians being encouraged to be excited is aimed at the pipeline, not at physicians themselves.

pick.title: Why every health care AI company must face Epic
pick.headline: Health Tech Startups Free to Disrupt Anywhere Epic Has Already Approved
pick.take: Every AI company promises to transform clinical care, and every one needs access to the system where clinical care is documented. Disruption is available to all, pending integration review. Physicians, who will use whatever survives that process, are encouraged to be excited about the pipeline.
